text:
sasha: FYI gitops apply for `nv6-ap-south1` is blocked by Conftest/OPA when trying to add a NAT gateway for the new GPU pool. plan fails in the pipeline.

matt: ugh, which policy is tripping? can you paste the error?

sasha: here, from the terraform plan step in the pipeline: ```Error: OPA policy violation
rule: egress-restricted
msg: creating public egress (nat_gateway) in ap-south-1 is blocked by policy:
resource: google_compute_router_nat.nv6-nat
```

anjali: is this the normal egress freeze window? i thought we allowed infra exceptions for capacity emergencies.

sasha: It's not a freeze-window change exactly — policy is a hard deny for public egress in certain regions unless an exemption is in place. We need a temporary exception to reach external registry endpoints and to pull some CUDA container layers during boot for the NV6 nodes.

jaime: can we avoid NAT by using private Google access + artifact mirroring to internal bucket? how urgent is the capacity need?

sasha: timeline: customers on the dedicated tier are seeing queued inference jobs. We expect queuing to hit SLO within 3 hours if we don't provision extra NV6 nodes. Mirroring would take too long this afternoon.

kelsey: cost note: NAT gateway in ap-south-1 is ~ $0.045/hr + egress charges; but the alternative (standby VMs to NAT images) will cost more. We should document cost for the exception.

matt: request: can we get a 6h exception scoped to the terraform change only, with audit log and a rollback plan? Also prefer canary: create 2 NV6 nodes first, verify boot & images, then scale to pool size.

ops-approvals-bot: Automated checklist: please provide (1) justification, (2) blast radius, (3) mitigation & rollback plan, (4) duration. Reply with `@ops-approvals-bot approve <hours>` for fast-track.

sasha: justification: emergency capacity to avoid customer job queueing; blast radius: network egress only in ap-south-1 for resource `google_compute_router_nat.nv6-nat`; mitigation: restrict NAT to private subnets for only bootstrap CIDRs, apply IP allowlist for registry hosts, enable flow logs, canary = 2 nodes; rollback: terraform destroy nat + scale down nodepool; duration: 6 hours.

jaime: please add smoke test steps to the PR/merge message: (1) node bootstrap logs show image pull success, (2) GPU drivers loaded, (3) runtime container health-check passes.

matt: pinging @anjali for security sign-off on IP allowlist and flow logs.

anjali: will review. quick checklist: 1) ip allowlist entries (exact FQDNs/IPs), 2) validate no wide-open 0.0.0.0/0 rules, 3) ensure audit export to secure bucket. If all good, i can +1 for 6h.

sasha: added allowlist to the PR as `var.registry_ips` (small CIDRs) and enabled `flow_logs = true` on the nat subnetwork.

deploybot: Pipeline status: `gitops/terraform-plan` -> FAILED (policy: egress-restricted). Waiting for manual approval. Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234

ops-approvals-bot: @sasha please confirm duration in the exact approval command format.

sasha: @ops-approvals-bot approve 6h — exception covers terraform change id `pr/4852` only. Audit: https://audit.internal.redwood/tx/7890

ops-approvals-bot: Exception request received. Notifying approvers: @anjali, @jaime.

anjali: reviewed PR snippets, allowlist CIDRs ok, flow logs set, audit export path ok. Security +1 for 6h scoped exception.

jaime: ops +1. recommend canary rollout guard in helm: set `replicaCount: 2` for canary release and add `maxUnavailable: 1` in podDisruptionBudget. Also add a quick metric check: successful GPU init + <200ms additional boot latency.

ops-approvals-bot: Exception APPROVED for 6 hours (scoped: terraform `pr/4852`, resources: `google_compute_router_nat.nv6-nat`, region: ap-south-1). Audit token: EXC-2026-319.

matt: awesome. Sasha: once apply finishes, follow canary steps and post outcome here. I'll watch the pipeline.

sasha: running `terraform apply` now in the emergency workspace. will post plan/apply snips if it errors.

sasha: apply success — nat created, initial 2 NV6 nodes created. smoke checks: ```node-boot: image pull ok
node-gpu: nvidia-smi shows 1 GPU
container-health: /health => 200```

kelsey: thanks — please add the actual egress bytes & cost estimate to the PR for postmortem.

matt: rolling to full pool now with autoscaler target. scaling policy: +8 nodes over 30m.

deploybot: Pipeline: terraform-apply -> SUCCESS. GitOps: sync -> in-progress.

sasha: marking exception resolved in the PR and closing after 6h expiry. will paste cost & bytes.

ops-approvals-bot: Reminder: exception will auto-revoke at timestamp 1937656921 unless renewed. Please ensure cleanup if still needed.

jaime: nice work. postmortem: include why mirroring wasn't feasible and a follow-up item to pre-stage images in the region for future capacity spikes.

sasha: noted. creating ticket: COREINFRA-927 to pre-stage registry mirrors in ap-south-1.

matt: thanks team. :thumbsup:
